This first Teacher is like a virtuous physician who thoroughly understands the origins of the four diseases and skillfully masters the essentials of the eight arts.

The *Āgama* Sūtras state that a skilled physician possesses four qualities.
First, knowing the disease;

third, knowing the method of treatment.
Having known the four [truths], they do not arise again;

First, he knows suffering.

Ordinary beings who can cure the afflictions of two realms are inferior physicians;

Furthermore, the non-Buddhists (tīrthikas) who treat illness so that it recurs are inferior physicians.
Those of the Two Vehicles (śrāvakas and pratyekabuddhas) who treat illness such that it may or may not recur are mediocre physicians.
